WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4. Where a spell's tooltip disagrees with the text here, trust the text: tooltips can lag behind a hotfix. No source had posted a level 30 build when this page was written. Every build below is our own, fitted to the launch tree's point costs, because the published level 20 lists no longer fit it. No guide has recommended them.

What Arcane is for

Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. 3/3 keeps 50% of your regeneration running through every cast. That is what pays for Arcane BlastArcane BlastLevel 20 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 5Cast1.5 sec castCost15% of base ManaRange30 yd rangeBlasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 15% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec from time of initial application., whose mana cost climbs +100% per cast.

Icy Veins rates it 4/5 for levelling; Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish no levelling score. Its heading is "A Solid Leveling Spec": "Arcane Mages in Forever level up very well… The Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. talent significantly reduces downtime between fights… and Missile BarrageMissile BarrageTalentCastInstantGives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec. reduces the mana cost of Arcane Missiles by 100%."

In Classic, Arcane Power raid builds spent their damage casts on Frostbolt instead of the Arcane tree's own spells; ClassicWoW.gg puts it plainly: "Forever gives you Arcane Blast and Missile Barrage to build around Arcane-school damage itself."

The dungeon caveat: "if the tank is not good enough, you will pull aggro… the Arcane Mage cannot slow enemies as effectively as a Frost Mage (but still sufficient)."

Stat priority

Icy Veins is the only one of the three tracked sources that ranks Arcane's stats; its order:

  1. Hit — "your best stat until the cap", though low-level gear rarely carries much of it
  2. Spell Power (Arcane) — "the most sought-after stat"
  3. Spirit — ranked above Intellect on purpose: "Spirit is a powerhouse… works while you cast, especially with Mage ArmorMage ArmorLevel 34 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost270 ManaDuration1800 secIncreases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 1800 sec. and Arcane MeditationArcane MeditationTalentCastInstantAllows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting."
  4. Intellect — a bigger mana pool and a small crit bonus
  5. Critical strike — take it when it's on gear, but "only gets really powerful when you have 5 talent points in Arcane MindArcane MindTalentCastInstantIncreases your Intellect by 10% and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane spells by 100%."
  6. Stamina — comes along for free on most gear
  7. MP5 — lowest priority; usually a healer stat
